scenes.name: Synth-pop
scenes.book: Loops 1 y 2. Una historia de la música electrónica
scenes.author: Javier Blánquez (ed.)
scenes.desc: Las melodías del pop imperial descubren la tecnología electrónica: cambian las texturas, no la intención de crear himnos generacionales.

podcast.title: "The Messiah of Pop" Designation in the 80s
podcast.body: During the 1980s, Vince Clarke was recognized by Melody Maker as "the messiah of pop" due to the consistent and significant success of his various musical endeavors. "Melody Maker lo llamaba el mesías, el poco en la época de los 80."

podcast.title: Complicated Personality and Project Evolution
podcast.body: Vince Clarke's personality, described as "quite complicated," led to continuous changes in projects and names, causing some fans to lose track of his work. This difficulty also contributed to strained relationships, such as the one with Alison Moyet in Yazoo. "por la mejor por su personalidad bastante complicada, que siempre ha tenido y por esos continuos cambios de proyectos y de nombres."

podcast.title: Extensive Pre-Erasure Material
podcast.body: Before meeting Andy Bell and forming Erasure, Vince Clarke had already recorded dozens of songs, awaiting a suitable singer to complete them. This readiness allowed for a rapid release of early singles once Andy Bell joined. "ya Vince Clark tenía grabadas de cenas de canciones solo al esperar de un cantante."

podcast.title: Founding and Departure from Depeche Mode
podcast.body: As a founding member of Depeche Mode, Vince Clarke was instrumental in their initial success, almost single-handedly composing, recording, and producing their first album before his departure. He then moved on to form Yazoo. "Al final él trabaja en el principio de Petchmo, los convierten famosos, los abandona para formar de azú con Alisson Boyet."

podcast.title: One of Modern Music's Greatest Geniuses
podcast.body: Vince Clarke is regarded as one of the most brilliant minds in modern music, though his complex personality and frequent changes in projects and band names may have prevented him from receiving broader mainstream recognition. "Vince Clark, que es posiblemente uno de los grandísimos genios de la música moderna que hemos tenido."
